where_to_look: The dividend. Evolution's whole equity story is an uninterrupted quarterly cash dividend (most recently $0.12/share, declared alongside results). The unpriced binary is whether it is held, trimmed or covered out of the revolver, and the answer is in the release's declaration paragraph and the coverage ratio, not in the EPS line the three estimates point at. Prior release for the shape: https://ir.evolutionpetroleum.com/news-releases/news-release-details/evolution-petroleum-reports-fiscal-first-quarter-2026-results

State production data, which is public and leads the print by months. Texas RRC, Louisiana DNR SONRIS and New Mexico OCD lease-level volumes for Delhi, Chaveroo, Jonah, Barnett and Hamilton Dome effectively pre-announce the volume half of the quarter. Nobody at a $133m cap does this.

The borrowing-base redetermination and any hedges put on since the last 10-Q — both are 8-K/10-K items and both bound the dividend question above. Check the recent filing list at https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=0001006655

Note the option chain is unusable (ATM legs not two-sided, 381 contracts total open interest), so the 3.99% 'expected move' in the baseline is a historical median, not a market price. There is no option-implied anchor for this name.
